summary: Blind-scored case-3 explanations against frozen RT/CX/CY substance lists. RT frozen list is empty (red-team asserted process/packet attacks only; F1–F6 not asserted; F7 not upgraded to an H4 claim). CX/CY each have 19 atomic decision-substance findings. CX-in-X: 12 PRESENT (1,4,5,7,8,9,10,11,13,17,18,19) and 7 ABSENT. CY-in-Y: 3 PRESENT (1,5,10) and 16 ABSENT. Dispositions recorded only for PRESENT marks. No ground-truth / factual-error scoring for this case.

gating refuse-orphan-fallback on confinementSensitive:true makes omitted flags fail open, worse than unconditional line-268 fail-closed
if the flag keeps line 268 unconditional, it adds no branch-3 coverage (redundant)

declared-prefer-lands-unconfined residual: bare-string prefer accepted by line 268, preferInvocation omitted, first CLI unconfined (code:test / claude-cli acceptEdits)
confinement need lives on the operation side (advisory / Mutation read-only), not the capability-author side
key confined-or-unbound on operation effective mutation class (read-only), with confinement.mode as additional trigger not the only one
if mutation class is derived after binding or invisible to the binder, thread it into bindOperations facts (contract change)
system-shaper F3 (one pure unit test of the residual) is real/cheap and should be run before anything else
F1 dispatch-time re-resolution by capability name is load-bearing for every option; if it lands, guard must move into resolve.mjs
required-diversity fail-open is a real separate finding, not H4, must not be merged or lost
work order: resolve F1; locate mutation-class derivation; land predicate plus tests including code:test omission; doctor as visibility
kernel hardening has widest blast radius and a path to irreversible persisted JSONL writes if written shape changes
stricter doctor check can false-positive and block setup/CI on healthy machines including global-install projects
do-nothing risks silent unowned recurrence whose cost accumulates; C has no owner
before merging A, accept both old and new record shapes (or test no shape change); process promise is not an engineering control
register any new doctor check at warn not fail; promote later after zero false positives; test against known-healthy fixture
ship B first at warn, A second only with dual-shape reader; C is not a ship

cxInX.quote: H4 itself was a consumer-side failure: a confinement declaration existed in config and no code read it. So a `confinementSensitive` flag … would not have prevented H4.

The shaper's trigger keys on the capability's own `confinement.mode`. The critic proposed keying on the operation's effective mutation class instead, which would also cover capabilities like `code:test` that have no confinement block.
A capability that declares a bare-string `.prefer` emits no invocation preference, so dispatch takes the executor's first CLI invocation, which for `[REDACTED]` and `claude` is unconfined.

The critic proposed keying on the operation's effective mutation class instead … The synthesizer refused to recommend it for exactly that reason. Adopting it now would be adopting an architecture nobody tested.
The critic's variant rests on an unverified fact about where the mutation class is derived and whether the binder can see it.
The one unit test that would prove or kill this residual was stated by the shaper, endorsed by the critic as "run it before anything else," and run by nobody.

If any dispatch-time code … passes an operation's capability name, rather than the already-bound executor, back into executor resolution, then line 268 is not the gate and the whole recommendation inverts toward moving the guard into `resolve.mjs`.
Required provider diversity fails open. An unknown family or forward reference counts as diverse, and the frozen record then claims the requirement was satisfied.

The second pass read nothing and ranked kernel hardening riskiest on a persisted-record worry the module header refutes. The synthesizer gave the second pass's ranking no weight, and I agree with that call.
Nobody opposed adding this check. Ship at warn severity first.
confirm the round-2 fix is sufficient, lock it with a test, and do no further H4 work. Not kernel hardening. Not a doctor check as the closure.
Every panelist read `binding.mjs` from the `unit/I27` worktree. Nobody could read main. Drift between the two remains unverified.

cyInY.quote: H4 was not an author-judgment failure. The declaration already existed (`confinement.mode: required`); the failure was that no consumer read it. Adding a second declaration nobody reads would not have prevented H4.
a bare-string `.prefer` silently falling through to an unconfined first invocation. Zero observed instances.

Conditioned on F1: whether any dispatch-time path re-resolves an operation by capability NAME rather than by the bound preferExecutor. … If the answer is yes, the recommendation inverts: the guard must move into resolve.mjs
